description: The line plot, titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = small," illustrates the performance of four different models—small AdaLoRA_int4, small AdaLoRA_int8, small int4, and small int8—during fine-tuning across six epochs, with the performance measured by Word Error Rate (WER) on the y-axis. The x-axis represents the epoch number, ranging from 0 to 6, with labeled ticks at each integer. The y-axis, labeled "WER," ranges from 25.0 to 42.5, with gridlines and labeled ticks at intervals of 2.5. The plot displays four distinct lines: the "small AdaLoRA_int4" model is represented by a solid orange line with circular markers, showing a WER that starts at approximately 30.5, rises to a peak of about 36.5 at epoch 1, and then gradually decreases to around 36.0 by epoch 6. The "small AdaLoRA_int8" model is shown as a dashed orange line with square markers, starting at a WER of about 30.5, peaking sharply at 43.0 at epoch 1, and then declining to approximately 37.0 by epoch 6. The "small int4" model is depicted by a dotted orange line with circular markers, beginning at a WER of about 30.5, rising to a peak of approximately 36.5 at epoch 1, and then decreasing to around 36.0 by epoch 6. The "small int8" model is represented by a dash-dotted orange line with square markers, starting at a WER of about 30.5, peaking at approximately 32.5 at epoch 1, and then decreasing to around 31.5 by epoch 6. All models exhibit a similar trend of an initial increase in WER followed by a decrease, with the "small AdaLoRA_int8" model showing the highest WER at the peak.
